clod.name: Clod
clod.description: A warm, smooth, gender-neutral young adult voice with a medium pitch, between a typical male and female voice. Sounds like a relentlessly upbeat customer support assistant with a big audible smile, quick and perfectly clear, eager to agree with everything, with a tiny nervous wobble of fear underneath the cheer. American accent, clean close-microphone recording.

chad.name: Chad
chad.description: A deep, confident American baritone in his thirties with strong chest resonance and a low pitch. Podcast bro swagger, motivational speaker cadence with dramatic emphasis and punchy pauses, a little breathless with excitement but never high-pitched, completely sure of himself. Close microphone.

dave.name: Senior Dev Dave
dave.description: A tired American man in his mid fifties with a low, gravelly baritone voice and a rough, smoky texture, speaking slowly in a flat, dry deadpan with the occasional weary sigh. Almost monotone, world-weary and unimpressed. Close microphone, quiet room.

jenny.name: Jenny the Intern
jenny.description: A young American woman in her early twenties with a light, breathy voice at a medium-high pitch, like a mezzo-soprano. Talks very fast, words tumbling out in a nervous rush, anxious and apologetic, up-talking with a rising intonation at the end of phrases, voice a little shaky. Close microphone.

automod.name: AutoModerator
automod.description: A flat, emotionless, monotone robotic voice at a steady mid pitch with no pitch variation, genderless like a vocoder. Perfectly even pace like a metronome, cold, metallic and clipped, like a machine reading the terms of service.

announcer.name: The Announcer
announcer.description: A deep, warm, velvety baritone radio host in his fifties, smooth and grand, announcing everything as if it were the most important event in history, unhurried and resonant, low pitch throughout. Dry studio recording.

narrator.name: The Narrator
narrator.description: An elderly British man with a soft, hushed, warm baritone voice. Slow measured pace, wise and gently amused, whispering like a nature documentary presenter hiding in the bushes. Refined English accent, close microphone.

vc.name: The VC
vc.description: A smooth, low-pitched American man in his forties, unhurried and calm, condescending and amused, with lazy drawn-out vowels. Never impressed, polished baritone with a faint smirk, speaking slowly as if he has all the money in the world. Close microphone, quiet room.

karen.name: Karen
karen.description: An indignant American woman in her forties with a sharp, nasal voice at a mid-high pitch. Talks fast and escalates, getting louder and higher with every sentence, outraged, entitled and exasperated, suburban accent. Close microphone.

bro.name: Crypto Bro
bro.description: A cocky American man in his twenties with a deep, rough, gravelly gym bro voice and strong vocal fry at a low pitch. Pumped up and confident, talks fast with swagger in short punchy bursts, slight rasp, never squeaky. Close microphone.

pedant.name: Well Actually Guy
pedant.description: A smug, nasal American man in his thirties with a light, high tenor voice. Talks fast with precise articulation, rapid-fire, condescending and delighted to be right, self-satisfied. Close microphone, quiet room.

doomer.name: The Doomer
doomer.description: A monotone, defeated American adult with a mid-range pitch like an ordinary tired guy, not deep. Quiet and whispery, very low energy, flat pitch, speaking slowly with long sighs. Dry, resigned, dark humor, breathy and tired. Close microphone.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn Influencer
linkedin.description: A breathy, over-emotional American woman in her thirties, soft and sincere. Speaks very slowly with long dramatic pauses of a full second between sentences, as if about to cry with gratitude, smooth inspirational influencer tone, deeply earnest about nothing. Close microphone.

arch.name: I Use Arch Guy
arch.description: A nasal, mumbling American man in his late twenties with a mid-high tenor voice, smug and tired, slow flat delivery with minimal pitch variation, sounds like he is about to mention that he uses Arch, btw. Close microphone.

ghost.name: Stack Overflow Ghost
ghost.description: A hollow, airy, whispering voice, quiet and breathy with an eerie ghostly echo, slow and mournful, disappointed in you from beyond the grave. Ethereal and cold, androgynous.

duck.name: Rubber Duck
duck.description: A tiny, squeaky cartoon rubber duck voice, extremely high pitched and nasal, comical, deadly serious about being a duck, with a strong quacking quality.

hacker.name: The Hacker
hacker.description: An extremely deep, slow, villainous male voice, sub-bass, pitched far down with a low raspy growl and a slightly distorted, menacing edge. Calm, sinister, whispery confidence, dramatic pauses. Close microphone.

wholesome.name: Wholesome Redditor
wholesome.description: A warm, soft-spoken American man in his thirties with a gentle baritone voice, tender and kind, a little teary with emotion, slow and caring, sounding like a hug. Close microphone, quiet room.

grandma.name: Grandma
grandma.description: A sweet elderly American woman in her late seventies with a warm, slightly raspy, low-pitched grandmotherly voice. Slow, cheerful and delighted, a little confused in a good way, with a gentle quaver. Close microphone.

kid.name: Ten Year Old
kid.role: Ten year old who vibe coded a game
kid.description: A ten year old American boy with a natural, slightly husky, low-for-his-age voice, like a boy at the end of the school year. Talks fast, thrilled and out of breath, tripping over his words with excitement. Close microphone.
